question: Should OpenClaw restore `PluginRuntime.channel.turn.*` as a deprecated object-identical alias of `channel.inbound.*` for old shipped and third-party channel plugins?
rationale: The code repair is narrow, but repository policy treats Plugin SDK/API compatibility as a maintainer-owned exception to the default no-alias cleanup rule, and current docs explicitly say the alias was removed.

options.title: Accept the deprecated alias
options.body: Resolve the current conflicts and land the PR as a compatibility shim, with `channel.inbound.*` remaining canonical for new plugin code.

options.title: Reject the alias
options.body: Close this PR and keep the documented removal, requiring affected plugin authors to publish releases that call `channel.inbound.*`.

options.title: Accept only with a removal plan
options.body: Land the alias after adding a maintainer-approved compatibility window or deprecation/removal note beyond the current docs wording.

recommendation.title: Accept the deprecated alias
recommendation.body: Resolve the current conflicts and land the PR as a compatibility shim, with `channel.inbound.*` remaining canonical for new plugin code.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant runtime alias removal and channel inbound refactor history are most directly tied to this owner path.
